information: ![Logo del Club de Speedcubing Chileno](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTUzOTY2LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--8f2cfa20491e61c6702ea10cdcc478da84e4b129/Plantilla%20Afiche.png) **Español** Nos complace anunciar la primera competencia de speedcubing en el Estadio Sausalito de Viña del Mar en 2026, esperamos poder recibir a la mayor cantidad de competidores posibles y que este sea un evento emocionante para competidores, familia y amigos. Los esperamos ansiosos!!! **English** We are pleased to announce the first speedcubing competition at the Estadio Sausalito de Viña del Mar in 2026. We hope to welcome as many competitors as possible and make this an exciting event for competitors, family, and friends. We look forward to seeing you there!
